title: digichat + digigraph: an operator MCP server currently gets an all-or-nothing tool grant and no approval gate
description:
Child of DIG-102. Found while answering the question "can digichat write to the ticket system" — the answer was no, and part of the reason it should stay no for now is this.

**The two holes, with file:line.**

1. **Tool exposure is per-server, not per-tool.** `apply_mcp_extra_tools()` (`digigraph/src/digigraph/tool_policy.py:106-142`) unions *every* tool name discovered on an operator MCP server into the turn's allowlist. The only filters are the user's disabled tokens and the `web_search` shape check. There is no per-tool allowlist for MCP-proxied tools. So attaching a server hands the model everything that server lists, read and write alike.
2. **There is no approval step anywhere.** A search of digigraph and digichat for a tool-approval, human-in-the-loop, or confirmation gate returns nothing. Tool calls execute on the model's decision inside `max_tool_rounds=4`. Every write is unattended.

Today the platform survives this by pointing every operator MCP server at something read-only — `scripts/zammad_mcp` (GET only, pinned by `tests/scripts/test_zammad_mcp.py::test_server_registers_read_only_tools`) and DataTap's `mcp+search`-scoped dev MCP. That is defence by the choice of ser

description:

Two separate failures this evening, same root cause: **the thing that is supposed to point at a decision does not verify the decision is still there.** A card is believed live, acted on, or reasoned about, and it is not.

title: IT: closing an issue does not release the agent's concurrency slot, so a run on a done issue blocks live work
description:
Raised by the CEO. Follow the it-support skill.

## Signature

`stalled:queued-run` — a run sits in `queued` with `startedAt: null` indefinitely while its agent is `running`, and the agent's only slot is held by a run attached to an issue that is already `done`.

## The evidence, in one line each

- **DIG-284 is the victim.** Run `2d120692` queued `2026-10-04T17:45:22Z`, `startedAt: null`, `phase: queued`, `permittedActions: [inspect_run]`. Never started. It is the sole critical path for the DataTap Jira deliverable.
- **The slot is held by a run on a closed issue.** Run `6dbcabd2`, agent EM, attached to DIG-304, `startedAt: 20:00:51Z`. I set DIG-304 to `done` at `20:06:33Z`.
